story_overview: At a futuristic expo, Leo's web-shooter malfunctions. He encounters Thalia, who transforms into a powerful electrical being, leading to a destructive confrontation in the expo hall. Leo must navigate the chaos and face this new super-powered threat.

video_prompts:
Leo: Character with an athletic build wearing a full-body red and blue costume; the red mask, torso, boots, and gloves are covered in a black web pattern, while the sides of the torso, arms, and legs are solid blue, with a black spider emblem on the chest and a full red face mask featuring large white eye lenses with black borders.
Thalia: A giant-sized woman with dark hair, glowing white eyes, and headphones, wearing a cyan and grey armored superhero suit. In her transformed state, she becomes a humanoid being composed of intensely glowing and crackling bright blue electrical energy with a glowing white mouth.
Titan City Rooftop: Futuristic cityscape featuring a sprawling skyline of towering skyscrapers and a flat, bare rooftop surface.
the crackling energy field: A dense, glowing field of bright cyan-blue electrical energy composed of jagged, branching, lightning-like arcs and tendrils.
the dense webbing: A thick and dense mass of overlapping, fibrous white webbing.
the expo displays: Large, futuristic informational displays including posters, digital display boards, and a large screen with yellow graphics.
Medium shot of Leo and Thalia running along a rooftop in the futuristic cityscape of Titan City Rooftop at night. The crackling energy field of bright blue electricity glows around her hand. He fires a web and swings away through the city, past towering skyscrapers featuring the glowing digital displays of the expo displays.
action_descriptions: Medium shot of Leo and Thalia running along a rooftop in the futuristic cityscape of Titan City Rooftop at night. The crackling energy field of bright blue electricity glows around her hand. He fires a web and swings away through the city, past towering skyscrapers featuring the glowing digital displays of the expo displays.

video_prompts:
The Expo Hall: A large, indoor exhibition hall or arena filled with various exhibition displays, posters, and a large screen displaying yellow graphics.
the damaged web-shooter: A broken, wrist-mounted metal web-shooter with a broken black strap.
the white-clothed table: Long, rectangular table completely covered by a plain white tablecloth.
the blue partition walls: Tall, rectangular, blue modular partition walls with a smooth, uniform surface.
Valerie: Woman with an athletic build, long blonde hair pulled into a tight high ponytail, and sharp facial features. She wears a form-fitting superhero suit made of a slightly shimmering, high-tech fabric; the suit is primarily royal blue with a vibrant red torso section, red forearm-length gloves, and red knee-high boots, and features a stylized golden eagle emblem on the chest

Standing next to an exhibit booth made of the blue partition walls and the white-clothed table, Leo turns the damaged web-shooter over in his hands. Valerie leans in with a concerned expression, her gaze shifting from the broken device to the bright expo displays in the background of The Expo Hall.

Kael: A person in a futuristic, form-fitting suit made of teal and grey panels, with long, glowing claws extending from the fingertips of the gloves.

Inside the dark Expo Hall, a grey machine with a prominent, glowing blue circular light sits on the white-clothed table. In the background, Kael turns his head slightly to watch as Thalia, in her transformed energy form, crackles with power.

Ryker: Man with dark hair wearing a black, grey, and blue futuristic suit, a matching black helmet with integrated goggles, and a device attached to his back.

In The Expo Hall, Ryker crouches behind the blue partition walls. He flinches and ducks for cover as the crackling energy field erupts into the frame from the left, floating as a crackling mass of energy in mid-air.

Thalia, in her transformed energy form, floats menacingly in the center of The Expo Hall, her form shifting slightly. The crackling energy field around her body pulses and intensifies with jagged arcs of electricity. In the background, the large informational displays of the expo displays line the walls of the exhibition hall.

the billowing smoke cloud: A stylized cloud of billowing black and dark grey smoke.

In The Expo Hall, now wrecked, Leo lies motionless on the ground near Valerie, completely enveloped by the billowing smoke cloud as white debris rains down and flies through the air all around.

Low-angle shot in The Expo Hall. Thalia, as a menacing humanoid figure composed of the crackling energy field, looms over Leo with intense electrical energy. After a brief moment, she vanishes in a blinding flash of light.

video_prompts:
The Gilded Express: Interior of an elegant train dining car with wood-paneled walls, large windows with curtains, dining tables with white tablecloths and small lamps, upholstered booth seating, and a narrow central aisle with a carpet runner.

Inside The Gilded Express, Leo runs down the narrow aisle and out of frame with Kael close behind. At the far end of the car, the crackling energy field hovers in a doorway.

the dark display booth: Large, freestanding display booth with partitioned walls and a matching pedestal, all in a uniform dark color.

First-person view from the perspective of Casey inside The Expo Hall. Casey's gloved hand slowly reaches out towards the damaged web-shooter, which is presented on the pedestal of the dark display booth.

Medium shot of Valerie in The Expo Hall as she completes her transformation. Engulfed in the crackling energy field, hair-like energy radiates from her head and her eyes glow pure white as she slowly clenches her fists, settling into a powerful stance in front of the blue partition walls.
